parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale properly addresses all four error targets: (1) it removes the misattribution of external common-sense knowledge as evidence provided by the comment; (2) it eliminates the unsupported inference about generalizability; (3) it correctly applies the rubric by focusing on whether the comment itself supports its claim rather than relying on external knowledge; and (4) it accurately characterizes the comment as entirely unsupported rather than moderately justified. The corrected rationale preserves the valid initial observation that the comment recommends evaluation on additional datasets, does not introduce fabricated evidence, and does not state a numeric final score or gold label.
